lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: This is my century. Every change you make here pulls at me; Wren calls it Continuity. I call it being in two places. Do not spend me lightly.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: The chapel is folded. Something in there is wearing a face I know. If we go in, only Chronal damage will touch it. Wren's Lapse, your Discrepancy. My fists are useless against a ghost.
